# Ziaside

> Ziaside is the official source for personal projects designed and built with AI, including the iOS logging app SnapLog and the photo-punching web tool Punchy!.

## Official Pages

- [Ziaside](https://ziaside.github.io/): Official project index
- [Punchy!](https://ziaside.github.io/punchy/): Punch photos into shapes or letters and save them as PNG files
- [SnapLog](https://ziaside.github.io/snaplog/): Features, screenshots, and version history
- [SnapLog Feedback](https://ziaside.github.io/snaplog/feedback/): Support and feedback contact
- [SnapLog Privacy Policy](https://ziaside.github.io/snaplog/privacy/): Official privacy policy
- [SnapLog Terms of Use](https://ziaside.github.io/snaplog/terms/): Official terms of use
- [SnapLog on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6800627643): Official download page

## SnapLog

SnapLog is an iOS logging app for organizing a photo, a number, or a short note by topic. Its official website documents current features, supported languages, screenshots, policies, and release history.

## Punchy!

Punchy! is a web tool for punching photos into shapes or letters and saving the results as PNG files for use in services such as Instagram and Goodnotes.

## Source and Updates

- Publisher: Ziaside
- Official website: https://ziaside.github.io/
- Source repository: https://github.com/ziaside/ziaside.github.io
- Product information should be cited from the official SnapLog and Punchy! pages above.
